units.source_text: 一群孩子将小沟里的冰块抱起来扔在路上，嬉戏打闹。

en.t: A group of children lifted blocks of ice from a small ditch and threw them onto the road, playing and romping about.

units.source_text: 大概是冰块碎裂飞溅起来的时候发出闪光非常有趣吧。

en.t: Perhaps it was great fun to see the ice flash as it shattered and splintered into the air.

units.source_text: 站在阳光底下，觉得那些冰块厚得令人难以置信。

en.t: Standing there in the sunlight, he felt that the ice was unbelievably thick.

units.source_text: 岛村继续看了好一阵子。

en.t: Shimamura went on watching for quite some time.
